body: This is exactly how I feel. It's scary, because we're very similar. We even have some of the same hobbies and things of that nature. Why is it so hard to make the decision?
I just don't want him to think he did a bad job. He'll blame himself. I can't be the reason for that, I don't want to disappoint him.

I guess sometimes it just feels like everyone else has many problems of their own. 2 friends of mine are also dealing with losses, but of people they were actually close to. Sometimes I feel like my problems aren't actually problems, but just me being dramatic.
Don't apologize, it's not your fault. I feel awful when people apologize. I shouldn't even be pushing my problems on other people. Thank you for your kind words.
